title: Audience member with magnetic ear implant at Area 52 show

tellings.quote: he had an experience when he was a child and he has something very similar in his ear and he could put a magnet externally on it and it'll stick there.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that at a live show he did with another podcast, Area 52, hosted by Chris Ramsey, an audience member told of a strange experience as a child. Michels says the man has something in his ear, similar to the implants discussed on the show, and a magnet held to the outside will stick to it. If true, it would be physical evidence tied to a childhood encounter.
